quests.desc: Welcome to TextWorld! First, it would be a great idea if you could make an effort to travel south. And then, try to go to the east. If you can succeed at that, take a trip north. And then, make an effort to move east. Then, retrieve the cauliflower from the couch within the playroom. And if you do that, you're the winner!

Well, here we are in a kitchen. You begin to take stock of what's here.

 You make out a fridge. Suddenly, you bump your head on the ceiling, but it's not such a bad bump that it's going to prevent you from looking at objects and even things.[if c_0 is open and there is something in the c_0] The fridge contains [a list of things in the c_0]. There's something strange about this thing being here, but you don't have time to worry about that now.[end if][if c_0 is open and the c_0 contains nothing] What a letdown! The fridge is empty![end if] Hey, want to see a pan? Look over there, a pan. [if there is something on the s_0]On the pan you can make out [a list of things on the s_0].[end if][if there is nothing on the s_0]But the thing is empty. objective: Get ready to pick stuff up and put it in places, because you've just entered TextWorld! First off, make an effort to head south. Then, try to take a trip east. With that accomplished, go north. That done, attempt to take a trip east. That done, take the cauliflower from the couch within the playroom. And once you've done that, you win!
